name: yo-url-yo-json
description: Extract validated JSON from webpages using JSON Schema, Camoufox, llm-scraper, and Codex CLI.

scripts.build: bun build --target=bun --packages=external --outfile=dist/yo-url-yo-json.js commands/index.ts && bun build --target=node --packages=external --outfile=dist/yo-url-yo-json-node.js commands/index.ts && chmod +x dist/yo-url-yo-json.js dist/yo-url-yo-json-node.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && npm pack --dry-run
